output.title: IP-in-commonName SAN handling change may affect deployed Certificate resources
output.content: The environment's manifests use `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate`, and the `certificates.cert-manager.io` [v1] CRD is installed. That is the resource type this v1.18.0 bugfix changes. Per the release note, if a certificate has an IP address in its `commonName` field, that IP is no longer added to the DNS `subjectAlternativeName` list and is added to the `ipAddresses` field instead. The environment summary does not show what the Certificate manifests contain, so check each one for an IP address in `commonName`, and check whether any client relies on that IP appearing as a DNS SAN.
